testInfo.summary: This test calls the authorization endpoint test twice. The second time it will include prompt=none with the id_token_hint set to the id token from the first authorization, and the authorization server must return successfully immediately without interacting with the user. The test verifies that auth_time (if present) and sub are consistent between the id_tokens from the first and second authorizations.
